meta: Link Squarespace forms, email, scheduling and payment tools so leads and orders reach the right place. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Connect Squarespace to email, scheduling and payments
overview: We connect your Squarespace site to the tools you rely on, so form entries and orders do not get lost. We link forms to your email list or CRM, add scheduling tools such as Acuity or Calendly, connect payment and invoice tools, and set up Google Analytics. We use Squarespace's native connections first, then Zapier or Make when needed, test with real entries and document what is linked.

faq: Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Google Workspace, Acuity, Calendly, Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks and many more. If a tool has a Squarespace extension, an embed or a Zapier link, we can usually connect it.
Acuity Scheduling is owned by Squarespace but billed as its own plan. Prices change, so check the current ones. We set up the tool you choose in your account and style it to match your site.
Who pays for Zapier or Make?
If an automation needs one, the subscription is yours and billed by them. We use native options first and tell you before building anything that adds a monthly cost.
Can you add tracking pixels for ads?

Yes, for common ad platforms, using the code each platform supplies. We follow platform rules and set tracking to respect consent where you need it. We never set up anything that collects data against the rules.
